svg.title: XIAO RP2040 breakout hookup
svg.desc: Component side, USB-C at the top. Rows 9 to 3 go down, and columns J to A go left to right. J and B are the main headers. A7 through A9 duplicate power rails.
svg.text: Component side · USB-C up · Find pads by their printed coordinates
By header, left to right and top to bottom
A9 and B7 remain available as spare rail taps.
Blue circles show installed access headers. Each numbered row has two isolated strips, A–E and F–J.
Breakout D9 = USB 5 V. XIAO D9 = MISO at breakout B5.
